name: discord-alerts
//deps: No runtime dependencies. Posting to a webhook is one fetch, which Bun and Node 22 both ship. drizzle-orm and postgres are resolved from the repo root on purpose: this package imports the web app's table definitions from ../src/db/schema.ts, and drizzle's types are nominal, so a second installed copy makes the root's PgTable objects unassignable here. Install the root package first; there is nothing to install in this directory.
